canDoYue: 你識客氣咁話菜凍、未煮熟、等太耐，並接受換菜同免費甜品。
canDoEn: Say the dish is cold or undercooked, ask for a replacement, and accept a complimentary dessert.

dialogue.speaker: ruth
dialogue.text: Excuse me please, Suki. I ordered the soup, but the bowl arrived cold at our little table.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思，Suki。我叫咗湯，但係送到檯嘅碗湯係凍嘅。
dialogue.say: Excuse me please, Suki. I ordered the soup, but the bowl arrived cold at our little table.

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: I understand the problem with the cold soup, and I can replace that bowl with a hot one.
dialogue.glossYue: 我明白凍湯嘅問題，我可以換一碗熱嘅。
dialogue.say: I understand the problem with the cold soup, and I can replace that bowl with a hot one.

dialogue.speaker: ruth
dialogue.text: The side dish looks undercooked after the long wait, because the meal came much too late.
dialogue.glossYue: 配菜睇落未煮熟，因為等得太耐，個餐出得太遲。
dialogue.say: The side dish looks undercooked after the long wait, because the meal came much too late.

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: The manager can replace the whole dish with a fresh hot plate if that suits you best.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果呢個啱你，經理可以換一碟新鮮熱嘅。
dialogue.say: The manager can replace the whole dish with a fresh hot plate if that suits you best.

dialogue.speaker: ruth
dialogue.text: Could you please bring a complimentary warm dessert for both of us after you fix that plate?
dialogue.glossYue: 換完之後，可唔可以畀我哋兩份免費甜品？
dialogue.say: Could you please bring a complimentary warm dessert for both of us after you fix that plate?

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: I will send that dessert right away, and I will tell the kitchen about the plate.
dialogue.glossYue: 我即刻送甜品過去，同埋話畀廚房知嗰碟。
dialogue.say: I will send that dessert right away, and I will tell the kitchen about the plate.

dialogue.speaker: ruth
dialogue.text: Please do not let the cold soup happen again when we come back for a side dish.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋下次返嚟食配菜，唔好再出凍湯。
dialogue.say: Please do not let the cold soup happen again when we come back for a side dish.

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: I appreciate your patience with us, and the kitchen will heat the soup properly because you waited.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝你耐心等，廚房會熱返碗湯，因為你等咗。
dialogue.say: I appreciate your patience with us, and the kitchen will heat the soup properly because you waited.
